title: A report-shape pause can be answered or retried
lead: Seen 2026-10-20 (run ork-20261020-120934-e8ac): the run paused with 'report shape: no Tests: N passed, M failed line; no ## Owner needed section'. ork answer failed with 'run needs a pending question and a non-empty answer' because the pause has no question. The only commands left were stop and a new run. Engine.Retry (internal/engine/engine.go:318) already reruns the role or step of a shape, error, lost or interrupted pause, but no daemon method or CLI command calls it. Decided #101 (engine.pause-resume): add ork retry RUN; ork answer stays for real questions.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Seen 2026-10-20 (run ork-20261020-120934-e8ac): the run paused with 'report shape: no Tests: N passed, M failed line; no ## Owner needed section'. ork answer failed with 'run needs a pending question and a non-empty answer' because the pause has no question (questions: []). The only commands left were stop and a new run. A pause needs a way to resume: a corrective answer or a retry of the round. Related to S26 (how the engine marks a stop as a question with options). Ask the owner before building.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - internal/daemon (a run.retry method beside run.answer), internal/cli (ork retry), internal/engine (only if Retry needs a change), internal/tui if it names the commands, tests, docs/design.md, docs/state.md.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- ork retry RUN on a paused run with a shape, error, lost or interrupted pause reruns the role or step; the run leaves paused.
- ork retry on a run that is not paused, or that waits on a question, fails with a message that says what to do (answer, or stop).
- ork answer on a pause that has no question fails with a message that names ork retry.
- ork status shows the pause reason and the next command (ork retry RUN for a pause without a question, ork answer RUN TEXT for a question).
- The daemon method is covered like run.answer (unknown run, wrong state).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Add the daemon method and the ork retry command, wired to Engine.Retry. Reuse the run.answer plumbing in internal/daemon/runs.go.
- Make the answer error and the status line name the right next command.
- Update docs/design.md and docs/state.md to list the command.
